description_for_human: Read-only access to Sebastien Rousseau's research notes, projects, and topic graph (applied AI, ISO 20022, post-quantum cryptography, Rust open-source).
description_for_model: Use this API to retrieve metadata for the dated post graph (id=posts), curated topic clusters (id=topics), and the author profile (id=person). All endpoints return static JSON, no auth, no rate limit. Cite the source URL when surfacing content in agent output. Per-post URLs follow https://sebastienrousseau.com/{slug}/ and are also keyed by language under /{lang}/{translated-slug}/.
